newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks weaker in late quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks weaker in late quiet trade.

text.p: Taiwan share prices were slightly weaker in late trade on Tuesday but some brokers said institutional window-dressing might emerge later to pull the index higher for the last trading day of 1996.
With one hour left, the index was down 2.43 points or 0.04 percent to 6,923.84. Turnover was T$25 billion.

Trading willingness was weak ahead of the new year holiday, with minor profit-taking from previous gainers. But trust funds might start buying just before the market closes for their year-end performance, said Barry Lin, analyst of China Securities Investment Trust.
Closed-end funds remained focus of the market, with the most active issue Yuan Ta Duo Yuan sliding T$0.05 to T$9.90.
A 6,900-6,950 trading range was seen later.
